author: National Geographic
description:
From producer Darren Aronofsky and hosted by Will Smith, One Strange Rock dives into the mysteries of the universe and reveals how planet Earth came to be. In this One Strange Rock MEGA episode, learn about the genesis of life, terraforming, and more, featuring three full episodes: 

Genesis
Our rock is special — it’s alive. Astronaut Mae Jemison reveals how somehow our planet cooked up stardust and made life.

Terraform
Astronaut Mike Massimino explains how life sculpted almost every part of Earth turning this once barren rock into a paradise.

Awakening
Of all life on Earth, we’re the only ones with the smarts to leave our planet. Astronaut Leland Melvin reveals how our planet makes us so intelligent.
